name: Runner Extras - NavApp GetModuleInfo By Id
brief: Issue #2961: NavApp.GetModuleInfo(appId, info) must answer for every app the runner has loaded, and must raise BC's own error for an id it has not.
description: Runner-mechanism claim. Which apps are loaded is a fact about the runner, so 'GetModuleInfo answers for the System Application' is only meaningful here. BC resolves the id against NavCurrentThread.TryResolveAppGroup().OrderedAppMetadata, which is empty on the skeleton, so every id missed: a precompiled app asking about itself got 'No installed extension was found with ID', and source-compiled AL got a silent false from a runner polyfill that ignored the DataError argument. Both now go through one implementation that answers from the runner's own module registry and reproduces BC's trap-versus-raise split.
